snippet.title: Air Assault 2: Missions 12 - 14 (Download Link in Description)
snippet.description:
Air Assault 2 is made by Divo Games, GameTop. It is a 3D action packed, adrenaline filled, apocalyptic survival experiment for the daredevils. Strap on tight, pilot, because there are 20 levels to complete, with over 100 different enemy units.

Mission 12: Flying Beast (00:10)
Mission 13: Treasures of Ancients (01:55)
Mission 14: Close Combat (03:46)
